title: Permanent pictorial cancellations
intro: Cancellations kept standing at a post office and applied on request. Each entry records the office, the date the cancellation was introduced and what it depicts.
_howToAddAnEntry: Copy one block from 'entries' below, paste it after the last one, and mind the comma between blocks.
'region' drives the filter buttons. The buttons build themselves from whatever values you use here, so if you invent a new region it appears on its own.
'specs' can hold any labels you like. Whatever you type on the left shows as the label.
'images' lists filenames inside the images folder. Leave the list empty and a blank stamp placeholder shows instead, so entries work before you have photographed them.
Every entry needs a unique 'id'. Use it as the image filename too and you will never lose track of which scan belongs where.
